parent.start_msg:
Hi! I help you create a personalized Telegram bot for your audience (free: {{count}} bot(s)).

How it works:
1) You create a new bot in @BotFather (this gives you a token).
2) You tell me your bot name and description and default language.
3) I set the webhook and your bot becomes live.

Commands:
/create_bot — create your bot
/my_bot — show your bot settings
/delete_my_data — delete your data
parent.create_bot_msg:
To create your bot, I need the bot token from @BotFather.

Steps (you’ll answer 3 questions):
1) Bot name
2) Bot description
3) Default language

After creation:
- Your bot will respond to normal messages

Now paste the bot token as text.

parent.bot_full_description:
AI Parent helps you create personalized Telegram bots for your audience.

✨ Features:
• Create custom AI bots
• Configure topics and language
• Build preference quizzes
• Send automated daily messages

Open the Mini App to manage your bots!
